name: Compound MIDDLE Composition Grammar
summary: Compound MIDDLEs follow a head-initial three-slot composition grammar with channel-specific slot modulation

test_1_head_position.name: Compound Head Position
test_1_head_position.result: H2 SUPPORTED: first atom determines category

position_gradient_3plus.note: Monotonic decline from first to last

test_3_free_atom_independence.name: k/t Position Independence
test_3_free_atom_independence.result: INVERTED: k and t are MOST position-sensitive, not least
test_3_free_atom_independence.interpretation: k-first=98.4% THERMAL (actor), k-last=88.3% MONITORING (target). FREE means positionally mobile with ROLE DUALITY, not behavioral invariance. JSD for k/t HIGHER than HEAD atom e.

test_4_terminal_carryover.name: Terminal-to-Head Carry-Over
test_4_terminal_carryover.result: CONFIRMED but weak, resets at line boundaries
test_4_terminal_carryover.interpretation: Terminal atoms carry weak probabilistic state forward (~1% variance explained). Signal resets at line boundaries (consistent with C1200, C1233).

test_5_composition_accuracy.name: Composition Grammar Prediction Accuracy
test_5_composition_accuracy.interpretation: Head-only model correctly predicts intrinsic FUNCTION (what the MIDDLE does) but fails to predict PREFIX-derived CHANNEL (which subsystem deploys it). edy is operationally THERMAL but deployed by ch/sh MONITORING channel. Two independent readable layers: MIDDLE composition = action, PREFIX = channel.

test_6_channel_slot_grammar.name: Channel-Specific Slot Grammar
test_6_channel_slot_grammar.result: PARTIALLY CHANNEL-SPECIFIC: universal skeleton with channel-specific slot assignment

kt_role_reversal.interpretation: k=actor under qo/ol, k=target under ch/sh. Complete role reversal by channel.

checkpoint_enrichment.note: d (checkpoint) enriched in monitoring, absent from iteration

cross_channel_consistency.note: 17 atoms tested. TERMINAL atoms universal. FREE atoms most channel-specific.
